knownIssues.title: Air conditioning refrigerant loss and compressor wear
knownIssues.description: Weak or absent cooling from a slow refrigerant leak or worn compressor, typically from around 90,000 km; comfort issue only.

fixes.summary: Recharge refrigerant and seal a leak
fixes.steps: 1) Confirm low pressure / leak with gauges or dye. 2) Tools: gauges, dye, R134a, vacuum pump. 3) Vacuum, seal leak, recharge to label weight. 4) Run A/C ~15 min; check pressures and vent temp. 5) Escalate if condenser/evaporator needs recovery gear.

fixes.summary: Replace a seized or noisy A/C compressor
fixes.steps: 1) Confirm noisy, seized or non-engaging clutch. 2) Tools: compressor, receiver-drier, refrigerant, vacuum pump. 3) Recover refrigerant, replace compressor and drier, evacuate. 4) Recharge and check cold air and pressures. 5) Workshop job - needs recovery equipment.

fixes.summary: Clean or replace a blocked condenser
fixes.steps: 1) Confirm high head pressure and debris/bent fins. 2) Tools: soft brush or air, fin comb, condenser if needed. 3) Access condenser, clean or replace, evacuate/recharge. 4) Check head pressure and airflow. 5) Escalate if replacement needs recovery gear.

knownIssues.title: Ignition coil pack failure causing misfires
knownIssues.description: Intermittent coil failure causes rough idle, hesitation and misfire codes, often from ~100,000 km; prolonged misfire can damage the catalytic converter.

fixes.steps: 1) Confirm misfire cylinder via OBD-II codes. 2) Tools: scanner, matching coil(s), plug socket if needed. 3) Disconnect battery, swap faulty coil(s). 4) Clear codes and recheck after a short drive. 5) DIY with basic tools; escalate if misfires persist.
